approvalBoundaries: No launcher activation in this package.
No ECS task execution in this package.
No PostgreSQL role or grant mutations in this package.

expectedActions: Add execution and task IAM roles (no updates to shared execution role)
Add dedicated diagnostic security group and exactly one RDS ingress rule
Add dedicated diagnostic ECR repository and CloudWatch log group
prohibitedActions: Any Modify/Delete/Replace action in existing stacks

phases.name: create-dedicated-iam-roles
expectedOutputs: Both role ARNs resolve in iam get-role.
Execution role contains no resource wildcard except ecr:GetAuthorizationToken.
rollback: Delete only newly created role policies and roles if downstream phases are not approved.

phases.name: create-dedicated-network-boundary
awsCommands: aws ec2 create-security-group --group-name genesis-staging-s2g-db-admin-diagnostic-sg --description "Staging S2G DB admin diagnostic task egress-only" --vpc-id vpc-05035503df7e142d6

aws ec2 authorize-security-group-egress --group-id <new-sg-id> --ip-permissions IpProtocol=tcp,FromPort=443,ToPort=443,IpRanges=[{CidrIp=0.0.0.0/0,Description='HTTPS via NAT for ECR/Secrets/Logs/S3'}]
expectedOutputs: Dedicated SG has zero ingress rules and one PostgreSQL egress rule.
RDS security group allows inbound 5432 from new SG.
rollback: Revoke ingress/egress rules and delete dedicated SG if task-definition registration is not approved.

phases.name: optional-private-endpoint-hardening
awsCommands: aws ec2 create-vpc-endpoint --vpc-id vpc-05035503df7e142d6 --service-name com.amazonaws.us-west-2.ecr.api --vpc-endpoint-type Interface --subnet-ids subnet-0f303dea5f645e42d subnet-00a0b287895a3b18c --security-group-ids <endpoint-sg-id> --private-dns-enabled

aws ec2 create-vpc-endpoint --vpc-id vpc-05035503df7e142d6 --service-name com.amazonaws.us-west-2.ecr.dkr --vpc-endpoint-type Interface --subnet-ids subnet-0f303dea5f645e42d subnet-00a0b287895a3b18c --security-group-ids <endpoint-sg-id> --private-dns-enabled

aws ec2 create-vpc-endpoint --vpc-id vpc-05035503df7e142d6 --service-name com.amazonaws.us-west-2.secretsmanager --vpc-endpoint-type Interface --subnet-ids subnet-0f303dea5f645e42d subnet-00a0b287895a3b18c --security-group-ids <endpoint-sg-id> --private-dns-enabled

aws ec2 create-vpc-endpoint --vpc-id vpc-05035503df7e142d6 --service-name com.amazonaws.us-west-2.logs --vpc-endpoint-type Interface --subnet-ids subnet-0f303dea5f645e42d subnet-00a0b287895a3b18c --security-group-ids <endpoint-sg-id> --private-dns-enabled
aws ec2 create-vpc-endpoint --vpc-id vpc-05035503df7e142d6 --service-name com.amazonaws.us-west-2.s3 --vpc-endpoint-type Gateway --route-table-ids rtb-0b31fdbbaf93fdeef rtb-06a8111c846284964

phases.name: create-ecr-repository-and-log-group
awsCommands: aws ecr create-repository --repository-name genesis-staging-s2g-db-admin-diagnostic --image-tag-mutability IMMUTABLE --image-scanning-configuration scanOnPush=true
expectedOutputs: ECR repository URI recorded for task definition.
CloudWatch log group exists before task definition registration.
rollback: Delete only the dedicated ECR repository and log group if phase D is not approved.

phases.name: build-and-publish-immutable-image
awsCommands: aws ecr batch-get-image --repository-name genesis-staging-s2g-db-admin-diagnostic --image-ids imageTag=<tag> --query 'images[0].imageId.imageDigest' --output text
expectedOutputs: Build evidence captures source SHA and vulnerability scan output.
rollback: Do not delete historical image digests; revoke by refusing future task-definition approvals.

phases.name: register-fixed-task-definition
expectedOutputs: Task definition ARN for family genesis-staging-s2g-db-admin-diagnostic.
Registered task definition retains fixed command, fixed host/db env, two secret selectors, and no ECS Exec.
rollback: Deregister only new revisions if approval is revoked before launcher update.

phases.name: update-launcher-approved-task-while-disabled
expectedOutputs: Change set shows task ARN update while LauncherActivationState remains DISABLED.
No enabled-only ECS/PassRole/Operator invoke policy attachment changes are activated.
rollback: Delete unexecuted change set if not approved; no stack mutation occurs.
